ST-17.title: CI minutes and artifact-storage visibility; explicit retention on the 3 uploads that lack it
ST-17.notes: AC1 (a monthly per-workflow figure exists) verified: scripts/generate_ci_usage_report.py generated a real first report, docs/ops/ci_usage_reports/2026-08.md (9958 runs, ~9755.6 estimated run minutes, 461.4 MB artifact storage, 36 workflows), committed to main; .github/workflows/ci-usage-report.yml schedules this monthly (1st of each month) going forward. Live token could NOT read the account-level Actions billing API (403, confirmed) but COULD read per-run timing + artifacts data via ordinary repo Actions-read access, so no disclosure-of-unavailability was needed for this AC (unlike ST-16). Two findings surfaced and disclosed rather than worked around silently: (1) this repo is public, so GitHub Actions billable-time is always 0 here - report tracks wall-clock run_duration_ms instead, labelled 'run minutes' not 'billable minutes'; (2) short-retention artifacts (7/14d) from a month closed >7 days before report-generation are already deleted by GitHub (not merely hidden) - the report computes and prints a per-workflow undercount caveat rather than presenting a silently-partial total as complete (confirmed live on the 2026-08 report: 22 days stale, 3 of 6 known artifact categories flagged). Because of this, the report is scheduled for the 1st of each month, while short-retention artifacts are still live. AC2 (all artifact uploads carry explicit retention) verified pre-met: fresh grep of all 6 actions/upload-artifact call sites (playwright.yml x3, smoke-tests.yml, production-db-backup.yml, update-visual-snapshots.yml) - all already carry retention-days (dated 2026-03-25/2026-04-26, predating this backlog item's 2026-09-19 filing); no code change needed (pre-met path, LL-v2.4-P4-02). Deviation check: none - Case C (test-authoring)/D (CI-infrastructure) combination; both new artefacts are their own governing spec.
